post.description: Start creating Connapse's GitHub App through GitHub's manifest flow, owned by the caller's account or by organisation, which GitHub must confirm is one. Creating it needs a browser: a person signed in to both Connapse and GitHub opens setupPageUrl and clicks once, or a browser posts a form with one field, manifest, to formAction. GitHub then sends that person back to Connapse, which stores the App. A stored App is replaced only with replaceExisting true. Each start is good for an hour, once, and only for the person who made it. Poll GET /api/v1/providers until the github requirement leaves Missing.

details.description: What the action changed, as the action records it; null when it records nothing.

config.description: The provider's settings; null when the connection has none.

scopeJson.description: Deprecated: send the typed "scope" instead. Still accepted for one minor release, then removed. Not allowed together with "scope".

error.description: A machine-readable code, or the error's text when there is no code.

message.description: The human-readable text, when error is a code.

field.description: The request member at fault, when there is one.

errors.description: Every reason, when a request failed for several: a list, or each request field's messages.

troubleshootingUrl.description: The setup guide's entry for this failure, when there is one.

traceId.description: The request's trace, to find it in the server's log.
